in_marathi.name: Akashay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akashay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akashay means 'Sky, Space'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Akasha', which means 'ether, sky, space'. In Hindu mythology, Akasha is the primal material from which the universe was created.
